title: Trove voice recording
description: One line of voice/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the clip was recorded / the voicemail was left

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

title.description: user/Apple-given memo title; voicemails rarely have one

sender.description: caller handle, voicemails only — E.164 where parseable, else as the source gave it

sender_name.description: display name for the caller, when the source supplies one

transcript.description: machine transcript text (Apple tsrp atom / voicemail PLIST / Google Voice HTML), full fidelity
examples: Remember to raise the caching question and push the demo to Thursday.

audio_ref.description: vault-relative path to the source audio (.m4a/.amr/.mp3); never inline audio bytes

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (Voice Memos recording UUID, device-UUID + voicemail rowid, a stable hash of the Google Voice conversation)

extra.description: everything source-specific (memo folder, voicemail read/trashed flags, per-word confidences, …)
